purpose: Measure snapshot size, save/load latency and deterministic replay equivalence including pending processes and version metadata.
seed_policy: Fixed recorded seed set and identical pre-save antecedents across repetitions.

workload_parameters.snapshot_shapes: versioned kernel states including pending process and identity allocator
workload_parameters.replay_span: recorded in result; must include at least one post-load causal consequence

duration_contract.value_source: Each result records transition count before snapshot and replay span after load.

instrumentation_contract: Record checksum/diff cost separately from save/load latency where material.
